read.thesis: Tesla says demand exceeds production and deliveries are production-constrained, with capex revised to about $20B and new financing up to $30B, but auto margins ex-credits rose only to 18.1% and Optimus volume is a year away.

utilisation.quote: our factories are operating at record rates this quarter

capex.quote: We're revising our CapEx guidance to be approximately $20 billion for the current year

triggers.label: Highest backlog in 4 years
triggers.quote: we exited the quarter with our highest backlog in 4 years, with deliveries constrained primarily by production
